name: town
mode: image-to-video from the town plate (design3/site/assets/plates/business.webp), fit pad to 16:9
prompt: Exactly as in the image: a handmade miniature diorama of an Indian snack business seen from above in soft morning light, a pale factory with two brick chimneys and a small office at the left, a corrugated godown warehouse full of brown cartons in the middle, a lane of colourful kirana shops at the right, a highway climbing to a small warehouse on a hill at the back right, a community kitchen with a blue awning at the back, and a thin softly glowing green path painted along the road. Over the clip the tiny yellow forklift rolls slowly out of the godown onto its forecourt, the small blue truck at the factory's loading bay pulls away slowly along the road toward the godown, the white van drives slowly up the highway, and a few tiny people walk about the kirana lane and the godown's gate. The glowing green path brightens gently once and settles. Every building stays exactly where it is, with the same shape, size and colours; nothing new appears; no text appears anywhere. Locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Soft even daylight, no lens flare.
encode: ffmpeg -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -crf 25 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart (1280x704, from LTX's own H.264)
use: smartclearance.com's hero film by day (SC-60, option A's hero), playing once over business.webp as its poster
